modern:
If gods do not care for me and my children,
There is a reason for it.
original:
If gods care not for me and my children,
There is a reason for it.
notification: If gods do not care for me and my children, / There is a reason for it.
notification_original: If gods care not for me and my children, / There is a reason for it.

explained.summary: Another line from Euripides: if the gods neglect me and my children, there is a reason for it. Marcus, who lost several of his children young, keeps it as a way of accepting even the hardest misfortunes as part of an order he may not understand.
